author: Megan Rawrs
title: Easily a 5 star game if these issues were resolved
content:
To continue gameplay you can either watch an ad for 10 secs or pay 800 coins for an extra 65 secs, which wouldn’t be a problem, but ….

The coin ratio is very, very low for continued gameplay to cost 800 coins. It should either cost less or more coins should be awarded for finishing levels.

After completing a level, there was an option to watch an ad for 50 coins. That has been lowered to 15 coins! And there aren’t many chances to do this; the option just disappears after a few times.

There are less chances to watch ads to continue gameplay which started when #3 happened. It simply doesn’t appear as an option. 

All of this leads me to believe that it’s done on purpose to force players to purchase coins. I get developers want to make a profit from their hard work, but this way isn’t it.

author: Player 96751
title: Great potential, poor execution
content:
The game is advertised to be a fun challenge of collecting as much as you can to clear the board. The theming is great, the art is fun and creative, unfortunately it is not as it seems. The game quickly goes from collecting all you can to dodge the bombs to win. Which on some level is nearly impossible because they are hidden inside of or under things you must collect to win. Then there’s the streak bonus challenges. Top prize is for winning 70 levels in a row, which sounds daunting, but not impossible. Unfortunately it’s just a complete lie. You actually have to win 380 levels in a row to get that prize. 
This game doesn’t want you to win, it just wants you to pay for bonuses. This game is not as advertised and I really do wish it was.
